print(f\"问题：{r['question']}\")\n    print(f\"回答：{r['answer'][:150]}...\")\n    print(f\"评分：{r['scores']}\")\n    print(f\"检索到的上下文片段数：{len(r['contexts'])}\")\n    print(f\"上下文预览：{r['contexts'][0][:100]}...\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 9 (markdown): Auto-attribution section\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 三、自动归因\n\n根据分层指标的得分模式，自动判断问题根因。\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 10 (code): Automatic attribution function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\ndef diagnose(case):\n    \"\"\"根据分层指标自动归因\"\"\"\n    s = case[\"scores\"]\n    \n    retrieval_score = (s[\"context_recall\"] + s[\"context_precision\"]) / 2\n    generation_score = (s[\"faithfulness\"] + s[\"answer_relevancy\"]) / 2\n    \n    diagnoses = []\n    \n    if s[\"context_recall\"] \u003c 5:\n        diagnoses.append({\n            \"layer\": \"检索层\",\n            \"issue\": \"召回不足\",\n            \"detail\": \"关键信息未被检索到\",\n            \"fix\": \"补充文档覆盖、优化 embedding 模型、增大检索 k 值\"\n        })\n    \n    if s[\"context_precision\"] \u003c 5:\n        diagnoses.append({\n            \"layer\": \"检索层\",\n            \"issue\": \"精度不足\",\n            \"detail\": \"检索了太多无关文档\",\n            \"fix\": \"减小 chunk_size、添加 rerank、优化 query\"\n        })\n    \n    if s[\"faithfulness\"] \u003c 6:\n        diagnoses.append({\n            \"layer\": \"生成层\",\n            \"issue\": \"幻觉\",\n            \"detail\": \"LLM 生成了上下文中没有的内容\",\n            \"fix\": \"强化 prompt 约束、降低 temperature、添加引用要求\"\n        })\n    \n    if s[\"answer_relevancy\"] \u003c 7:\n        diagnoses.append({\n            \"layer\": \"生成层\",\n            \"issue\": \"答非所问\",\n            \"detail\": \"回答没有针对用户问题\",\n            \"fix\": \"优化 prompt 模板、添加 query 重述\"\n        })\n    \n    if not diagnoses:\n        diagnoses.append({\n            \"layer\": \"综合\",\n            \"issue\": \"表现可接受\",\n            \"detail\": \"各维度得分均在合理范围内\",\n            \"fix\": \"无需紧急修复\"\n        })\n    \n    return diagnoses\n\nprint(\"归因分析报告\")\nprint(\"=\" * 80)\nfor i, r in enumerate(sorted_results[:5]):\n    print(f\"\\n--- Case {i+1}: {r['question']} ---\")\n    print(f\"评分：{r['scores']}\")\n    diags = diagnose(r)\n    for d in diags:\n        print(f\"  [{d['layer']}] {d['issue']}：{d['detail']}\")\n        print(f\"  修复方向：{d['fix']}\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 11 (code): Output attribution report table\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nprint(f\"{'问题':\u003c20} {'层级':\u003c8} {'问题类型':\u003c8} {'修复方向':\u003c30}\")\nprint(\"-\" * 70)\nfor r in sorted_results[:5]:\n    diags = diagnose(r)\n    for d in diags:\n        q_short = r[\"question\"][:18]\n        print(f\"{q_short:\u003c20} {d['layer']:\u003c8} {d['issue']:\u003c8} {d['fix'][:28]:\u003c30}\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 12 (markdown): From attribution to action\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 四、从归因到行动\n\n归因分析给出了问题的根因和修复方向。下面是每种根因对应的具体修复措施：\n\n### 检索层修复\n| 根因 | 修复措施 | 预期效果 |\n|------|---------|---------|\n| 召回不足 | 增大 k 值 / 换用更强的 embedding | Context Recall 提升 |\n| 召回不足 | 补充文档、优化切分策略 | 覆盖更多知识点 |\n| 精度不足 | 添加 Rerank / Cross-Encoder | Context Precision 提升 |\n| 精度不足 | 减小 chunk_size、增加 overlap | 减少噪声文档 |\n\n### 生成层修复\n| 根因 | 修复措施 | 预期效果 |\n|------|---------|---------|\n| 幻觉 | 在 prompt 中强化\"仅基于上下文回答\" | Faithfulness 提升 |\n| 幻觉 | 降低 temperature | 减少创造性输出 |\n| 答非所问 | 在 prompt 中重述用户问题 | Answer Relevancy 提升 |\n| 答非所问 | 添加 query 改写 | 更好理解用户意图 |\n\n### 修复优先级\n1. **检索优先**：如果检索层得分低，先修检索，因为\"检索不到就不可能回答好\"\n2. **一次改一个变量**：每次只修一个环节，跑评估看效果\n3. **回归测试**：修完后跑完整评估集，确保没有引入新问题\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 13 (markdown): Summary\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 五、小结\n\n### 关键要点\n1. **归因三步法**：分层 → 细分 → 定位根因，系统化而非猜测\n2. **归因矩阵**：每种异常模式都有明确的根因和修复方向\n3. **自动归因**：可以编写规则自动分类，加速问题定位\n4. **检索优先**：检索层是基础，优先修复检索问题\n\n### 实践建议\n1. 每次低分时都走一遍归因流程，避免盲目改动\n2. 记录归因历史，形成团队的问题知识库\n3. 定期回顾归因报告，发现系统性问题\n\n### 参考文献\n- [Diagnosing RAG Pipeline Failures](https://docs.ragas.io/)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## File 2: /Users/zhihu123/Project/other/llm-universe/notebook/C7 高级 RAG 技巧/7. 评估/6.CI_CD质量门禁与在线监控.ipynb\n\nChinese educational notebook about CI/CD quality gates and online monitoring.\n\nSame technical constraints as above.\n\nNotebook 6 structure (~16 cells):\n\nCell 1 (markdown): Title\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n# CI/CD 质量门禁与在线监控\n\n前置知识：本章 Notebook 2-5\n\n本节目标：将评估集成到开发流程中——用 DeepEval 编写 pytest 风格的评估测试，模拟 CI 质量门禁，并掌握在线监控的核心指标。\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 2 (markdown): Theory - why CI/CD for RAG\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 一、为什么 RAG 需要 CI/CD\n\nRAG 系统有多个可变组件：索引策略、embedding 模型、检索参数、prompt 模板、生成模型。任何一个组件的改动都可能影响最终质量。\n\n如果没有自动化评估：\n- 改了 prompt 以为变好了，但某类问题变差了 → **回归风险**\n- 换了 embedding 模型，不知道对哪些场景有影响 → **变更盲区**\n- 上线后才发现问题 → **线上事故**\n\nCI/CD 质量门禁的核心思想：**每次改动前，自动跑评估集，得分不达标就不允许合并代码。**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 3 (markdown): Theory - quality gate design\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 二、质量门禁设计\n\n### 门禁阈值\n| 指标 | 最低阈值 | 含义 |\n|------|---------|------|\n| Faithfulness | ≥ 0.80 | 答案必须有据可查 |\n| Answer Relevancy | ≥ 0.85 | 答案必须切题 |\n| Context Recall | ≥ 0.70 | 关键信息必须被检索到 |\n| 回归不退化 | Δ ≤ -0.05 | 任何指标下降不超过 5% |\n\n### 门禁流程\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n改动代码 → 自动触发评估 → 对比 baseline → 判断是否达标 → 通过/拒绝\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 版本化\n全链路都需要版本化：\n- 索引参数版本\n- Embedding 模型版本\n- Prompt 模板版本\n- 生成模型版本\n- 评估集版本\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 4 (code): Environment setup\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nimport os\nimport json\nimport time\nimport numpy as np\nfrom dotenv import load_dotenv, find_dotenv\n\nload_dotenv(find_dotenv())\nos.environ['HF_ENDPOINT'] = 'https://hf-mirror.com'\n\nfrom modelscope import snapshot_download\nmodel_dir = snapshot_download('BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5', cache_dir='./models')\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 5 (code): Initialize everything and build RAG\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nimport re\nfrom langchain_community.embeddings import HuggingFaceEmbeddings\nfrom langchain_community.chat_models import ChatZhipuAI\nfrom langchain_community.document_loaders import PyMuPDFLoader\nfrom langchain.text_splitter import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter\nfrom langchain_chroma import Chroma\nfrom langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate\nfrom langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser\nfrom langchain_core.runnables import RunnablePassthrough\n\nembedding = HuggingFaceEmbeddings(model_name=model_dir)\napi_key = os.environ.get(\"ZHIPUAI_API_KEY\")\nllm = ChatZhipuAI(model=\"glm-4-flash\", temperature=0.0, api_key=api_key)\n\npdf_path = \"../3. 索引阶段/data/pumpkin_book.pdf\"\n\ndef clean_text(text):\n    text = re.sub(r'→_→\\n.*?←_←', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL)\n    text = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', text)\n    return text.strip()\n\nloader = PyMuPDFLoader(pdf_path)\npdf_pages = loader.load()\ndata_pages = pdf_pages[13:-13]\nfor page in data_pages:\n    page.page_content = clean_text(page.page_content)\n\ntext_splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(chunk_size=500, chunk_overlap=50)\nsplits = text_splitter.split_documents(data_pages)\nvectorstore = Chroma.from_documents(documents=splits, embedding=embedding)\nretriever = vectorstore.as_retriever(search_kwargs={\"k\": 5})\n\ndef format_docs(docs):\n    return \"\\n\\n\".join(doc.page_content for doc in docs)\n\nprint(f\"RAG Pipeline 构建完成，共 {len(splits)} 个文档块\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 6 (markdown): DeepEval section\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 三、用 DeepEval 编写评估测试\n\n[DeepEval](https://docs.confident-ai.com/) 是一个 pytest 风格的 LLM 评估框架，可以像写单元测试一样写评估用例。\n\n安装：&#96;pip install deepeval&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 7 (code): Define evaluation functions using simple custom approach (since DeepEval may have compatibility issues, we demonstrate the concept with a custom implementation that mimics DeepEval's pattern)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\n# DeepEval 概念演示：pytest 风格的评估测试\n# 注：实际项目中推荐直接使用 deepeval 库\n\nclass LLMTestCase:\n    \"\"\"模拟 DeepEval 的 LLMTestCase\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, input_text, actual_output, expected_output=None, retrieval_context=None):\n        self.input = input_text\n        self.actual_output = actual_output\n        self.expected_output = expected_output\n        self.retrieval_context = retrieval_context or []\n\nclass FaithfulnessMetric:\n    \"\"\"模拟 Faithfulness 评估指标\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, threshold=0.8):\n        self.threshold = threshold\n        self.score = None\n        self.reason = None\n    \n    def measure(self, test_case):\n        context = \"\\n\\n\".join(test_case.retrieval_context[:3])\n        judge_prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template(\n            \"判断以下回答是否基于给定上下文。返回 0.0-1.0 的分数。\\n\\n\"\n            \"上下文：{context}\\n回答：{answer}\\n\\n\"\n            \"只返回一个小数，如 0.85：\"\n        )\n        chain = judge_prompt | llm | StrOutputParser()\n        resp = chain.invoke({\"context\": context, \"answer\": test_case.actual_output})\n        try:\n            self.score = float(resp.strip())\n            self.score = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.score))\n        except ValueError:\n            self.score = 0.5\n        self.reason = f\"Faithfulness score: {self.score}\"\n        return self.score\n    \n    def is_successful(self):\n        return self.score is not None and self.score \u003e= self.threshold\n\nclass AnswerRelevancyMetric:\n    \"\"\"模拟 Answer Relevancy 评估指标\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, threshold=0.85):\n        self.threshold = threshold\n        self.score = None\n        self.reason = None\n    \n    def measure(self, test_case):\n        judge_prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template(\n            \"判断以下回答是否切题回答了问题。返回 0.0-1.0 的分数。\\n\\n\"\n            \"问题：{question}\\n回答：{answer}\\n\\n\"\n            \"只返回一个小数，如 0.85：\"\n        )\n        chain = judge_prompt | llm | StrOutputParser()\n        resp = chain.invoke({\"question\": test_case.input, \"answer\": test_case.actual_output})\n        try:\n            self.score = float(resp.strip())\n            self.score = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.score))\n        except ValueError:\n            self.score = 0.5\n        self.reason = f\"Answer Relevancy score: {self.score}\"\n        return self.score\n    \n    def is_successful(self):\n        return self.score is not None and self.score \u003e= self.threshold\n\ndef assert_test(test_case, metrics):\n    \"\"\"模拟 DeepEval 的 assert_test\"\"\"\n    results = []\n    for metric in metrics:\n        score = metric.measure(test_case)\n        passed = metric.is_successful()\n        results.append({\n            \"metric\": type(metric).__name__,\n            \"score\": score,\n            \"threshold\": metric.threshold,\n            \"passed\": passed,\n        })\n    return results\n\nprint(\"评估测试框架定义完成\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 8 (code): Define test cases and run\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\ntest_questions = [\n    {\"question\": \"什么是信息增益？\", \"ground_truth\": \"信息增益是指在得知某个特征的信息后，信息不确定性减少的程度。\"},\n    {\"question\": \"什么是基尼指数？\", \"ground_truth\": \"基尼指数是度量数据集纯度的一种指标。\"},\n    {\"question\": \"过拟合和欠拟合的区别？\", \"ground_truth\": \"过拟合是训练好测试差，欠拟合是都差。\"},\n]\n\nprint(\"运行评估测试...\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nall_results = []\nfor q in test_questions:\n    docs = retriever.invoke(q[\"question\"])\n    answer = rag_chain.invoke(q[\"question\"]) if 'rag_chain' in dir() else \"\"\n    \n    # Need to define rag_chain first\n    rag_prompt_template = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template(\n        \"根据以下上下文回答问题。如果上下文中没有相关信息，请说'根据已有资料无法回答'。\\n\\n\"\n        \"上下文：\\n{context}\\n\\n问题：{question}\\n\\n回答：\"\n    )\n    rag_chain = (\n        {\"context\": retriever | format_docs, \"question\": RunnablePassthrough()}\n        | rag_prompt_template | llm | StrOutputParser()\n    )\n    answer = rag_chain.invoke(q[\"question\"])\n    \n    test_case = LLMTestCase(\n        input_text=q[\"question\"],\n        actual_output=answer,\n        expected_output=q[\"ground_truth\"],\n        retrieval_context=[doc.page_content for doc in docs]\n    )\n    \n    metrics = [FaithfulnessMetric(threshold=0.8), AnswerRelevancyMetric(threshold=0.85)]\n    results = assert_test(test_case, metrics)\n    all_results.append({\"question\": q[\"question\"], \"results\": results})\n    \n    status = \"PASS\" if all(r[\"passed\"] for r in results) else \"FAIL\"\n    print(f\"\\n[{status}] {q['question']}\")\n    for r in results:\n        flag = \"✓\" if r[\"passed\"] else \"✗\"\n        print(f\"  {flag} {r['metric']}: {r['score']:.2f} (阈值: {r['threshold']})\")\n    \n    time.sleep(1)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nActually, simplify Cell 8. \"上下文：\\n{context}\\n\\n问题：{question}\\n\\n回答：\"\n)\nrag_chain = (\n    {\"context\": retriever | format_docs, \"question\": RunnablePassthrough()}\n    | rag_prompt_tpl | llm | status = \"PASS\" if all(r[\"passed\"] for r in results) else \"FAIL\"\n    print(f\"\\n[{status}] {q['question']}\")\n    for r in results:\n        flag = \"✓\" if r[\"passed\"] else \"✗\"\n \n        print(f\"{q:\u003c20} {metric:\u003c20} {s1:\u003e6.2f} {s2:\u003e6.2f} {delta:\u003e+8.2f} {verdict:\u003e6}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nif gate_passed:\n    print(\"质量门禁：PASS - v2 prompt 可以合并\")\nelse:\n    print(\"质量门禁：FAIL - v2 prompt 存在退化，需要修复后重新提交\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 12 (markdown): Online monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 五、在线监控\n\n质量门禁保证了上线前的质量，但上线后仍需持续监控。核心在线指标：\n\n| 指标 | 含义 | 采集方式 | 告警阈值 |\n|------|------|---------|---------|\n| 追问率 | 用户在一次问答后继续追问的比例 | 会话日志 | \u003e 30% |\n| 拒答率 | 系统返回\"无法回答\"的比例 | 响应日志 | \u003e 15% |\n| 延迟 P95 | 95% 请求的端到端延迟 | 系统监控 | \u003e 5s |\n| Token 成本 | 每次问答的平均 token 消耗 | API 日志 | 超预算 |\n| 用户反馈 | 用户点赞/点踩比例 | 前端埋点 | 踩率 \u003e 20% |\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 13 (code): Online metrics collection example\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nimport datetime\n\nclass OnlineMetricsCollector:\n    \"\"\"在线指标采集器（演示用）\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        self.records = []\n    \n    def record(self, question, answer, latency_ms, token_count, is_refusal=False):\n        self.records.append({\n            \"timestamp\": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),\n            \"question\": question,\n            \"answer_length\": len(answer),\n            \"latency_ms\": latency_ms,\n            \"token_count\": token_count,\n            \"is_refusal\": is_refusal,\n        })\n    \n    def report(self):\n        if not self.records:\n            return \"无数据\"\n        \n        latencies = [r[\"latency_ms\"] for r in self.records]\n        tokens = [r[\"token_count\"] for r in self.records]\n        refusals = sum(1 for r in self.records if r[\"is_refusal\"])\n        \n        return {\n            \"total_queries\": len(self.records),\n            \"avg_latency_ms\": np.mean(latencies),\n            \"p95_latency_ms\": np.percentile(latencies, 95),\n            \"avg_tokens\": np.mean(tokens),\n            \"refusal_rate\": refusals / len(self.records),\n        }\n\ncollector = OnlineMetricsCollector()\n\nfor q in test_questions:\n    start = time.time()\n    answer = rag_chain.invoke(q[\"question\"])\n    latency = (time.time() - start) * 1000\n    is_refusal = \"无法回答\" in answer\n    collector.record(q[\"question\"], answer, latency, len(answer) * 2, is_refusal)\n\nreport = collector.report()\nprint(\"在线监控报告\")\nprint(\"=\" * 40)\nfor k, v in report.items():\n    if isinstance(v, float):\n        print(f\"  {k}: {v:.2f}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"  {k}: {v}\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 14 (markdown): Version management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 六、全链路版本化\n\n生产环境中，每次评估都需要记录完整的版本信息，确保可复现：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nversion_info = {\n    \"eval_date\": \"2026-03-15\",\n    \"eval_set_version\": \"v1.0\",\n    \"index_config\": {\n        \"chunk_size\": 500,\n        \"chunk_overlap\": 50,\n        \"embedding_model\": \"BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5\"\n    },\n    \"retrieval_config\": {\n        \"top_k\": 5,\n        \"search_type\": \"similarity\"\n    },\n    \"generation_config\": {\n        \"model\": \"glm-4-flash\",\n        \"temperature\": 0.0,\n        \"prompt_version\": \"v2\"\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n将版本信息和评估结果一起保存，方便后续对比和回溯。\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 15 (markdown): GitHub Actions example\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 七、GitHub Actions 集成示例\n\n以下是一个 CI 配置示例，在每次 PR 时自动运行评估：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# .github/workflows/rag-eval.yml\nname: RAG Evaluation\non:\n  pull_request:\n    paths:\n      - 'prompts/**'\n      - 'config/**'\n\njobs:\n  evaluate:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.10'\n      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt\n      - run: python -m pytest tests/test_rag_eval.py --tb=short\n        env:\n          ZHIPUAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZHIPUAI_API_KEY }}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n注意：这里只展示配置结构，实际 CI 还需要考虑向量库的缓存、评估数据的版本管理等。\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCell 16 (markdown): Summary\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## 八、小结\n\n### 关键要点\n1. **自动化评估**：每次改动都跑评估，用数据说话\n2. **质量门禁**：设定阈值，不达标不合并\n3. **版本对比**：对比变更前后的得分，量化改动效果\n4. **在线监控**：上线后持续追踪，及时发现退化\n5. **全链路版本化**：确保每次评估可复现\n\n### 实践建议\n1. **先建基线**：在引入 CI 前，先跑一轮完整评估建立基线\n2. **渐进式引入**：先监控不拦截，稳定后再开启门禁\n3. **合理设阈值**：阈值太严会阻塞开发，太松没有意义\n4. **保留历史**：所有评估记录都保存，用于趋势分析\n\n### 参考文献\n- [DeepEval 官方文档](https://docs.confident-ai.com/)\n- [Continuous Evaluation for LLM Applications](https://www.confident-ai.com/blog)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWrite BOTH files as valid Jupyter notebook .ipynb JSON files.
